description: This file defines a command handler class for creating a new customer in a CQRS pattern implementation. It handles the 'CreateCustomerCommand' request, constructs a Customer entity, persists it via a repository, and returns a CustomerDto.

classes.name: CreateCustomerCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the command to create a new customer, performs data mapping, persistence, and returns the DTO.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the create customer request, creates and saves a Customer entity, and returns a CustomerDto.
